description: The books' budget against posted income and expenses for a period (default this fiscal year to date): budget, actual, difference (actual minus budget) and percent of budget per category. breakdown=month or quarter adds a set of columns per fiscal month or quarter. Uses each fiscal year's active budget unless budgetId names one (list_budgets). A month the period covers only in part has its budget prorated by days: say it is an estimate when you quote it.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

budgetId.description: One budget version (an id from list_budgets); the active budget when left out.

period.description: A preset: this-month, last-month, this-quarter, last-quarter, this-fiscal-year, this-fiscal-year-to-date, last-fiscal-year. Or give from and to.

name: budget_vs_actual
title: Budget against actual
